summary.intent: Merge Wave 1's 5 worktree plan branches into the phase branch via `cleanup-wave`, run the post-merge integration gates (typecheck, tests, drift checks), and update ROADMAP tracking for Phase 68.
summary.outcome: All 5 worktrees merged cleanly and were removed; post-merge typecheck (6 packages in dependency order) and SDK Vitest suite (248 passed/49 skipped/0 failed) both passed; schema-drift gate passed while codebase-drift raised non-blocking stale-baseline noise; ROADMAP.md updated to 5/10 and committed.

repo: Post-merge build/typecheck gate is `pnpm typecheck`, which builds packages in dependency order crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk→web before typechecking web+scripts — this is the authoritative cross-package integration check.

`execute:wave:post` capability dispatch only wires the two `drift` gates (schema-drift blocking, codebase-drift advisory) in this config — the UI safety gate (`ui_safety_gate`) is not invoked at this point despite being relevant to frontend-touching plans.

The repo's codebase-drift baseline map can go stale, causing pre-existing files (`.learnings/`, `landing/`, `.husky/`, config, existing routes/barrels) to be flagged as 143 'new' elements when nothing actually changed.
workflow: `cleanup-wave` validates branch identity, base, merge result, and worktree removal per manifest entry, and reports each entry's status (e.g. `merged_removed`) plus overall exit code.

For post-merge test gates, deliberately scope to the SDK Vitest suite (browser-free) rather than full `pnpm test` — integration tests need a live API and web-e2e needs a running stack, both of which produce false failures and risk RAM starvation ([[feedback-gsd-concurrent-suites-ram]]).

friction: A diagnostic Node `require()` probe threw an unrelated error at the top of the cleanup-wave output, initially looking like a failure before being identified as a false alarm.
First typecheck run's output truncated before the web `tsc -b`/scripts step and the exit code wasn't captured cleanly, requiring a re-run (fast due to cached dist).
codebase-drift gate produced advisory noise from a stale baseline map, requiring manual judgment to confirm it wasn't real drift from Wave 1 changes.
open_items: Codebase drift baseline map is stale and should eventually be remapped, though not urgent enough to block mid-execution.
UI safety gate for 68-04's flagged tail-walk-accent ambiguity was not run as part of this post-merge dispatch — may need a separate/manual check against UI-SPEC.
